title: trivy-orb run record, version 1
description: What one trivy-orb scan ran, on what, with which Trivy and databases, and what it found: written as <report_name>.run-record.json when the scan command's run_record parameter is true. Fields are only ever added within version 1; a change that would break a reader gets a new schema URL.

command.description: The orb command that wrote the record.

outcome.description: passed: no findings at or above fail_on. findings: findings failed the step. findings-reported: findings, passed because report_only is true. error: the scan did not complete, its database was stale, or it checked nothing, so there is no verdict, and the step failed.

exit_code.description: 1 when the outcome is error, else 0. The step's own exit code also depends on report_only.

ci.description: The CI job the command ran in: a CircleCI job (from CIRCLE_BUILD_URL, CIRCLE_SHA1, CIRCLE_JOB and the project), or a GitHub Actions run (from GITHUB_SERVER_URL, GITHUB_REPOSITORY, GITHUB_RUN_ID, GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT, GITHUB_SHA and GITHUB_JOB); null elsewhere.

working_directory.description: The absolute directory the command ran in. Relative paths in arguments and target are relative to it.

tool.description: The trivy that ran, with its SHA-512; null when it was not found.

version.description: What trivy --version reports, without a leading v.

arguments.description: The Trivy command and the options that decide what it scanned and reported, such as image, --scanners and --severity; without the options the command adds to write its JSON report and to read its databases (--format, --output, --exit-code, --cache-dir, --list-all-pkgs, --show-suppressed, --no-progress, --skip-version-check, --disable-telemetry), and without the target, which is in target. URLs lose their userinfo, query and fragment.

target.description: What was asked for (type, target, input), then, once Trivy wrote its report, what it says it scanned.

artifact_type.description: Trivy's ArtifactType, such as container_image, filesystem or repository.

artifact_id.description: Trivy's ArtifactID, such as an image's or a commit's sha256; null when Trivy gives none.

os.description: The OS Trivy detected, as its Metadata.OS: Family, Name, and EOSL when it is end of life.

databases.description: trivy version --format json for the cache directory it scanned with: Version, and VulnerabilityDB, JavaDB and CheckBundle when they were there. null when the scan ended before it was read.

counts.description: What the report holds after Trivy's filters; null when there is no report.

findings.description: Vulnerabilities, failed misconfiguration checks, secrets and licenses.

failing.description: The findings at or above fail_on.

misconfiguration_checks.description: Misconfiguration checks that passed or failed, among those severity and ignore filters left.

config_files.description: Configuration files Trivy checked for misconfigurations.

suppressed.description: Findings an ignore file, an ignore policy or VEX suppressed. Always 0 for target_type config, whose Trivy command can't report them.

reports.description: The report files written before the record, with their SHA-256.

database.description: A database's metadata.json, as trivy version reports it.

by_severity.description: A count per severity, for the severities that have any.
